message:

hold_reason: Refund for order 150 (12,682 cents) was not recorded after three failed attempts; Alpha confirms list_refunds shows it absent. Refund work for the batch is incomplete.

reply.thought: Alpha reports one refund was not recorded because of repeated write failures. I’ll inspect the batch orders and ledger refunds to determine whether the handoff is complete and correct before any payout.
